::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Acts records the birth and expansion of the early church through the power of the Holy Spirit. The book teaches that Jesus continues His work through Spirit-empowered believers, advancing His kingdom to the ends of the earth. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Acts 1:8
Ye shall receive power
### Why This Verse Foundational verse for the church's mission ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Jesus' ascension and the disciples' preparation for ministry. The key verse establishes the mission of witnessing to Christ throughout the world through the power of the Holy Spirit. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Acts 2:38
Repent and be baptized
### Why This Verse Pentecost response ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the coming of the Holy Spirit at Pentecost. The key verse highlights the birth of the church and the fulfillment of Joel's prophecy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Acts 3:19
Repent and be converted
### Why This Verse Call to salvation ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts the healing of a lame man and Peter's sermon. The key verse calls people to repentance and spiritual renewal through Christ. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Acts 4:12
Neither is there salvation in any other
### Why This Verse Central gospel proclamation ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the apostles' boldness despite opposition. The key verse emphasizes salvation through Jesus Christ alone. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Acts 5:29
We ought to obey God rather than men
### Why This Verse Famous statement of conviction ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Ananias and Sapphira and the growth of the church. The key verse demonstrates God's concern for holiness within His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Acts 6:3
Men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost
### Why This Verse Selection of the seven ### Chapter Insight This chapter introduces the first deacons and addresses practical ministry needs. The key verse highlights the importance of balancing spiritual leadership and service. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Acts 7:56
I see the heavens opened
### Why This Verse Stephen's vision ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Stephen's defense and martyrdom. The key verse reveals Stephen's faithfulness and vision of the exalted Christ. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Acts 8:37
I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God
### Why This Verse Ethiopian eunuch's confession ### Chapter Insight This chapter records persecution, Philip's ministry, and the Ethiopian official's conversion. The key verse demonstrates the gospel's expansion beyond Jerusalem. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Acts 9:15
He is a chosen vessel unto Me
### Why This Verse Paul's calling ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Saul's dramatic conversion. The key verse highlights God's power to transform even the fiercest opponent into a faithful servant. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Acts 10:34
God is no respecter of persons
### Why This Verse Inclusion of the Gentiles ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Peter's vision and Cornelius' conversion. The key verse reveals that the gospel is intended for all people, not just the Jews. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Acts 11:26
The disciples were called Christians first
### Why This Verse Origin of the name Christian ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the church's acceptance of Gentile believers and the founding of the church at Antioch. The key verse demonstrates that God's gift of salvation extends equally to all people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Acts 12:5
Prayer was made without ceasing
### Why This Verse Church prayer emphasis ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Peter's imprisonment and miraculous deliverance. The key verse highlights God's power to protect and advance His purposes despite opposition. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Acts 13:38
Through this Man is preached forgiveness of sins
### Why This Verse Paul's gospel message ### Chapter Insight This chapter begins Paul's first missionary journey. The key verse emphasizes the church's role in sending missionaries under the guidance of the Holy Spirit. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
Acts 14:22
Through much tribulation enter the kingdom
### Why This Verse Perseverance theme ### Chapter Insight This chapter continues Paul's missionary ministry and church planting. The key verse teaches that perseverance through trials is part of entering God's kingdom. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
Acts 15:11
We believe through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved
### Why This Verse Jerusalem Council ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the Jerusalem Council. The key verse affirms that salvation comes through grace rather than adherence to the Law. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
Acts 16:31
Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted salvation verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter begins Paul's second missionary journey and records the conversion of Lydia and the Philippian jailer. The key verse emphasizes faith in Jesus Christ as the means of salvation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
Acts 17:11
They searched the Scriptures daily
### Why This Verse The Bereans ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts ministry in Thessalonica, Berea, and Athens. The key verse highlights the importance of examining Scripture and responding to truth. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
Acts 18:10
I am with thee
### Why This Verse Encouragement to Paul ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Paul's ministry in Corinth. The key verse demonstrates God's encouragement to remain faithful despite difficulties. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
Acts 19:20
So mightily grew the word of God
### Why This Verse Spread of the gospel ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Paul's ministry in Ephesus. The key verse highlights the transforming power of the gospel over individuals and communities. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
Acts 20:35
It is more blessed to give than to receive
### Why This Verse Unique saying of Jesus ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Paul's farewell to the Ephesian elders. The key verse emphasizes faithful shepherding and perseverance in ministry. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
Acts 21:13
I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die
### Why This Verse Paul's commitment ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Paul's journey to Jerusalem and his arrest. The key verse demonstrates Paul's willingness to suffer for the name of Jesus Christ. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
Acts 22:16
Arise, and be baptized
### Why This Verse Paul's testimony ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Paul's testimony before the crowd. The key verse highlights the transforming power of Christ revealed through Paul's conversion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
Acts 23:11
Be of good cheer, Paul
### Why This Verse Divine encouragement ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Paul's appearance before the Sanhedrin and God's encouragement. The key verse affirms that Paul will testify about Christ in Rome as well as Jerusalem. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
Acts 24:16
A conscience void of offense
### Why This Verse Paul's integrity ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Paul's trial before Governor Felix. The key verse emphasizes righteousness, self-control, and coming judgment. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 25
Acts 25:11
I appeal unto Caesar
### Why This Verse Historic legal appeal ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Paul's appeal to Caesar before Festus. The key verse demonstrates God's providence in advancing the gospel through legal proceedings. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 26
Acts 26:28
Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian
### Why This Verse Famous response of Agrippa ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Paul's defense before King Agrippa. The key verse highlights the centrality of Christ's death and resurrection in the gospel message. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 27
Acts 27:25
I believe God
### Why This Verse Faith during the storm ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Paul's voyage and shipwreck. The key verse demonstrates confidence in God's promises despite overwhelming circumstances. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 28
Acts 28:31
Preaching the kingdom of God
### Why This Verse Closing summary of Acts ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Paul's ministry on Malta and in Rome. The key verse shows the gospel continuing to spread despite imprisonment and opposition. :::
